## Operating snapshot

| Measure | Current signal |
| --- | --- |
| Customers in the operating plan | 4 — Lumen Labs, Ember Commerce, Fieldnote Studio, Harbor Mobility |
| Open renewal anchor | Lumen Labs — invoice 4471, **$412**, due 30 August; not overdue |
| Largest delivery risk | Scheduled exports reach the 120-second worker limit above 50k rows |
| Next release | 2.8 — export timeout and cancellation cleanup remain the gate |

This dashboard is a read-only view of the Northstar Relay fixture. The supporting records are available in the connected company apps.

## Renewal watch

- **Lumen Labs** — usage is up 38% since February. A 48k-row export finishes in 1m34s; 52k reaches the worker limit.
- **Ember Commerce** — scheduled exports support fulfilment reporting; the CSV header order issue is waiting for customer confirmation.
- **Fieldnote Studio** — attachment export is stable; the customer asked for an audit-history walkthrough.
- **Harbor Mobility** — a 75k-row scheduled export needs the worker timeout change before its renewal review.

**Next customer action:** send the tested Lumen workaround before 15:00 UTC. Keep billing separate from the export incident.

## Release 2.8 gate

| Check | State | Owner / evidence |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 50k-row load | Complete | Export worker test |
| 75k-row load | Complete | Export worker test |
| Cancelled-job cleanup | **Open** | Partial object still needs cleanup |
| Audit-page label fix | Isolated | Issue 322; outside the export branch |
| Release decision | **Blocked** | Keep 2.8 conditional until cancellation is safe |

The dashboard keeps the decision visible without turning an untested fix into a customer promise.

## People and follow-up

**Useful views:** customer renewals, support cases, release work, invoices, calendar decisions, and the Lumen renewal thread.
